messages:
sarah: Quick Q — during the SNI cert rotation yesterday we saw intermittent 502s on the ALB during the canary. Canary was 10% traffic, TF does a secret swap in-place. Has anyone hit this pattern before?

ajay: yep, seen that. Usually it's a probe/graceful-drain mismatch OR the gateway/controller reload when the secret changes. Which ingress/gateway are we using?

sarah: Gateway API -> aws-alb-controller + gateway-api-adapter. Service is behind an NLB -> ALB path (TLS terminated at ALB). externalTrafficPolicy is Cluster. Readiness probe is HTTP /ready (period 5s, failureThreshold 3). TG deregistration_delay is default 300s in tf module.

mike: two quick suspects: (1) pod terminationGrace < TG dereg delay so traffic can hit terminating pods; (2) controller reload briefly fails new connections if TLS secret swap isn't atomic.

linh: for (2) the gateway controller watches k8s secret; when you replace the secret name it updates the Gateway TLS reference which should be atomic, but if you patch the secret in-place the controller may reload certs and drop connections briefly. We did blue/green secret pattern for payments.

ajay: agree. Short checklist: set terminationGracePeriodSeconds >= deregistration_delay + safety margin OR lower deregistration_delay; add preStop to allow in-flight requests to finish; ensure readiness quickly flips to NotReady on SIGTERM.

sarah: can you sketch the preStop/readiness change? I can open a TF + k8s PR.

mike: example preStop snippet we used in staging:

---
preStop: |
  # let app finish inflight requests
  sleep 30
---

and set in Deployment: terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 90
readinessProbe: httpGet /ready initialDelaySeconds:2 periodSeconds:5 failureThreshold:2 timeoutSeconds:2

mike: and in TF for the target group: aws_lb_target_group {
  deregistration_delay = 60
}

linh: we tested: deregistration_delay 60 + terminationGrace 90 + preStop sleep 45 = no 502s during secret rotation when swapping by creating a new secret and updating gateway ref.

sarah: good. For the TF flow I propose we do blue/green secret rotate: create secret with suffix `-v2`, update gateway TLS ref, wait, then delete old secret. That avoids controller in-place reload glitch.

ajay: sounds good. TF hint: use `create_before_destroy = true` on the k8s_secret resource (in the k8s provider block) and add `lifecycle { replace_triggered_by = [kubernetes_manifest.gateway] }` where needed. Also add runbook steps to validate ALB cert via `openssl s_client -servername <host> -connect <alb>:443`.

sarah: I'll draft the PR: change TG dereg to 60 in module, add terminationGrace and preStop to deployment template, and update secret resource with create_before_destroy. Will run in staging first.

mike: ping me on the PR. For the canary run we should keep 5–10% traffic for 1h, watch 5xx rate, and watch pod lifecycles. I'll attach a quick `kubectl` snapshot command to grep terminating pods: `kubectl get pods -o wide --all-namespaces | grep Terminating` — in our staging run we saw zero after changes.

deploy-bot: terraform plan finished for modules/gateway (plan id t-2026-03-24). Diff: update aws_lb_target_group.drain_timeout (300 -> 60), kubernetes_secret.create_before_destroy = true, deployment.terminationGracePeriodSeconds = 90

sarah: thanks. Plan to open PR now, will tag @mike and @linh. After staging canary (1h) we'll promote. :thumbsup:

linh: small extra: confirm that ALB idle timeout > deregistration_delay to avoid connection resets (ALB idle default 60s). We use 120s in infra.

ajay: +1. Also add a checklist in PR description: runbook for rollback (set TG dereg back to 300? actually lower->higher risks, so rollback order matters).

sarah: noted. I'll include rollback steps and monitoring queries. PR in ~30m.

mike: thanks — will stand by for canary.

sarah: closing loop later with results.
